tools.name: llm_cost_estimate
tools.description: Cost in US dollars of calling one model, from the tokens in and out per request and the number of requests, at today's price. Handles cached input tokens and the batch price where the model has one. Use llm_price_lookup first if you are unsure of the model id.

tools.name: llm_cheapest_models
tools.description: The cheapest models that meet your constraints, ranked by price. Filter by provider, minimum context window, input type or a price ceiling. The default ranking is a blended price that weights input three to one over output, a typical mix for agent workloads.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: about_alexey_shurov · Private data: llm_price_lookup, llm_cost_estimate, search_shurco, about_alexey_shurov · Public sink: automation_roi, about_alexey_shurov.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: about_alexey_shurov · Private data: llm_price_lookup, llm_cost_estimate, search_shurco, about_alexey_shurov · Public sink: automation_roi, about_alexey_shurov

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
